{{Top|canon=Ter58 ion engine}}
The '''Ter58 ion turbine engine''' was a type of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] manufactured by [[Girodyne/Legends|Girodyne]]. The [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] had them installed in their [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]].
